changeSet.comment: Add the contract identifier columns to subscription

changeSet.author: vbusch
changeSet.comment: Backfill the contract identifiers onto unambiguously matching subscription segments
changeSet.sql: UPDATE subscription s SET vendor_product_code = m.vendor_product_code, license_id = m.license_id FROM ( SELECT seg.subscription_number, seg.start_date, MAX(c.vendor_product_code) AS vendor_product_code, MAX(c.license_id) AS license_id FROM subscription seg JOIN contracts c ON c.subscription_number = seg.subscription_number AND c.start_date <= seg.start_date AND (c.end_date IS NULL OR seg.start_date < c.end_date) AND c.org_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM seg.org_id AND c.sku IS NOT DISTINCT FROM seg.sku AND (seg.billing_provider IS NULL OR c.billing_provider IS NOT DISTINCT FROM seg.billing_provider) AND (seg.billing_provider_id IS NULL OR c.billing_provider_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM seg.billing_provider_id) AND (seg.billing_account_id IS NULL OR c.billing_account_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM seg.billing_account_id) GROUP BY seg.subscription_number, seg.start_date HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.vendor_product_code) <= 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.license_id) <= 1 ) m WHERE s.subscription_number = m.subscription_number AND s.start_date = m.start_date
